label: Night sky with thin clouds
source_prompt:
Paint a square, seamless material texture for a hand-painted fantasy game, in the same painterly style, brushwork and colours as the attached pictures.
- Seen straight on and flat, filling the whole picture edge to edge. No perspective.
- Seamless: the left edge must continue into the right edge, and the top edge into the bottom edge, so the square can repeat without a visible join.
- Even, flat light. No lamp glow, no bright patch, no vignette and no cast shadows. Only soft folds or grain.
- Only the material itself: no objects, no poles, no ropes, no ground and no sky.
- Even spread: nothing noticeably bigger, brighter or darker than the rest, because the square repeats many times.
- No text, no letters, no border and no signature.

Subject: a patch of starless night sky, deep plum-indigo, with thin wispy silver-lavender clouds drawn out in long soft streaks. No moon and no stars (the stars have not come back yet in the story). An even spread of wisps, nothing bigger or brighter than the rest.

Picture shape: wide (3:2).
